responsibility: This header defines the public interface to the mc-boot runtime's exception block and handler subsystem. It introduces the opaque exception-block handle and handler callback type and declares the operations for raising exceptions, switching the active block, managing handlers, querying stored exception text and numbers, controlling exception-state flags, and tracking the current exception source.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface side of GRTExceptions: it makes exception blocks opaque and declares handler-management, raise, and state-query operations, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GRTExceptions.cc implements the handler stacks, exception state, and raise/catch machinery.
